description: Every claim row has a declared claim state.
Action-to-claim compilation is deterministic and mapping-faithful.
Failure rows cannot carry positive or replication permission.
Supported units require a PGAA comparative-support witness.
Provisional units require PGAA descriptive evidence and no comparative witness.
Responder aggregation preserves row-level support, descriptive, and failure counts.
Stable units preserve state under every leave-one-method perturbation.
PGAA-dependent units contain an observed PGAA-omission state change.
External concordance requires a supported and internally stable unit.
Typed external states map to their declared replication ceilings.
The computational compiler cannot emit biological-validation permission.
Blocked, unresolved, discordant, provisional, or unstable counterfactuals cannot gain replication permission.
